name: syns
description: Auto-pull on Codex session start, auto-push on every turn-stop, and syns-init to build or join an agent-readable repository.

interface.shortDescription: Build or join a Syns repository; pull on start, push on Stop.
interface.longDescription: Includes the syns-init skill for digest-bound local proposal and evaluation before adoption, plus lifecycle hooks that pull a joined Syns repository on startup/resume and push on every turn-stop. Bundled hooks require trust.
